name: Chain LLM Example: Customer Email Triage (Groq)

options.systemPromptTemplate: You extract structured data from customer emails. Extract only what is explicitly stated. Do not infer or guess. If a field is not present in the email, omit it. Detect language from the actual email content. PII includes phone numbers, addresses, full credit card numbers, or government IDs.

parameters.text:
=Given this extracted customer data:

{{ JSON.stringify($json.extracted, null, 2) }}

Classify into one of: technical_issue, billing_question, cancellation_risk, upsell_opportunity, compliment, other.

Then identify the single most important next action (one short sentence).

Return JSON with keys: category, next_action, reasoning. No prose, no markdown.

options.systemMessage: You are a customer support triage analyst. You return only valid JSON. You do not invent categories outside the allowed list.
